name: ETL LinkedIn Community Management Data to MySQL
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **LinkedIn Community Management** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **MySQL** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Enter any desired Name for your credentials. Authorize DataChannel to connect to your LinkedIn account using OAuth.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/apollo/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
